source_snapshot.items: BMC I2C-10 to IO expander on HMC and both carrier-board IO expanders
source_snapshot.procedure: On BMC scan bus9 then forced reads of0x74 registers0x01 and0x00; PID1114953.
source_snapshot.criteria: Collect evidence/photos and check logs; no three-instance selector, register map or expected pin masks.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Notes one address cannot prove three paths but keeps physical inspection primary and does not separate device count from port-register count.

old_problem: Two registers at one0x74 may be ports of one device, not the HMC plus two carrier expanders; per-instance routes/parts, pin masks, direction/output safety, ownership and recovery are missing.
disposition_reason: All three expanders can be checked remotely, but ED-19 requires independent instance identity and ED-03 forbids guessing register roles. Forced raw reads on driver-owned GPIO devices need owner approval and explicit proof that directions/outputs remain unchanged.
decision_basis: Read XLSX row140, same-row AI fields and history2528; unique identity confirmed.
Preserved BMC I2C-10,bus9,0x74,registers0x00/0x01 and all three named expanders.
Distinguished adjacent port registers from separate physical devices and required per-instance routes/pin masks.
Rejected blind scan, default force, GPIO writes, invented probing, retry and DUT action.

test_case.test_name: BMC I2C-10 connectivity to three IO-expander instances
test_case.purpose: Verify the HMC, carrier-A and carrier-B IO expanders independently with read-only pin evidence and no GPIO state change.
required_package: PID1114953 bus9 route/selector/address for each expander
GPIO driver/consumer ownership and exceptional `-f` approval if required
Timeout/NACK criteria, state-preservation check and recovery
test_case.test_command: Do not broad-scan or force by default. Capture driver, direction and output baselines; through each authoritative route, read only the approved input/status registers for the HMC, carrier-A and carrier-B expander, compare pin masks, and verify configuration/outputs are unchanged; stop without retry on anomaly.
test_case.expected_result: Every identified expander returns its own expected pin/status mask, all three routes are evidenced, and directions, outputs, consumers and BMC/bus health remain unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires three independent device identities and pin-level comparisons. Two bytes from one device, missing instance, wrong mask, any GPIO transition, NACK/timeout/driver error or management regression fails.
safety_gate: Confirm exact part/register roles before raw access.
Use driver-safe interfaces; `-f` needs owner approval.
Never write direction/output/configuration registers or infer devices from register count.
One bounded read set per instance; preserve first failure and stop.
expected_evidence: PID routes and three device identities
Timestamped reads and expected/observed masks for all instances
Unchanged GPIO configuration/output, bus/BMC health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Reads should be state-neutral. If GPIO state changes, preserve evidence and use only the approved board-specific restoration; do not guess outputs or repeat automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Three physical devices are claimed from two undocumented offsets at one address; routing, pin oracle and ownership are absent.

blocked.reason: The per-instance read-only method is clear; platform maps/register contracts are resolvable RPUC prerequisites.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Three expander routes/parts, register and pin masks, driver-safe access, no-GPIO-change oracle and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; REQUIRES CONFIRMATION; NO DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.unlock_condition: Approve all three instance maps and read-only pin/state contracts, then revise the record.

project_authority: PID1114953 plus installed expander datasheets and GPIO consumer mappings define the OEM routes and safe state.
